ceu: ✦ The sextile between Venus and Jupiter

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, conversations and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Make a list of what you have already achieved and give thanks.

t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, money and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Look at yourself in the mirror with the tenderness you show the people you love.

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your image and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Sleep a little longer, if you can.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your inner life and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Do a friend a favour without expecting anything in return.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, friendships and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Say no to a task that is not yours.

t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your career and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Accept an invitation that is different from usual.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your horizons and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Speak frankly about a matter you keep avoiding.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Give way on something small to gain on something big.

t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, relationships and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Book that test or check-up you keep putting off.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, routine and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Allow yourself a sweet or a treat without guilt.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, romance and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Tidy a drawer or a corner of the house that bothers you.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, family and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Take a different route on your usual way.
